messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2025-12-19, the Atlas team took over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, having taken it over from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- The Atlas team owns the image resizer as of 2025-11-26, when ownership transferred from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the image resizer as of 2025-03-20. [decision; valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- As of 2026-06-04, Priya Raman has the Atlas team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-06-04]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team owns the bus, having taken it over from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: The Boreal team looks after the bus. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-05-20, when ownership passed from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30, when on-call passed from Tomasz. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-06-19, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-06-19 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-06-19]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-05-13, until the next rotation. [valid 2025-05-13 to 2025-06-19; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-13]
    earlier: Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-04-03, replacing Priya Raman. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-05-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team starting 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
- On 2025-07-30, on-call for the Atlas team passed from Tomasz to Priya Raman when Tomasz moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
- Tomasz was on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03, but left it on 2025-07-30 when he moved to the Dune team. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz is back on the Atlas team on-call rotation as of 2025-04-03. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-04-03]
    earlier: Tomasz had the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team but is off rotation as of 2025-02-12. [valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-12]
    earlier: Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar has the Ember pager, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of the 2026-04-13 cycle, Diego has the Ember pager, taking over from Oskar. [valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13]
- The catalog service still relies on the resizer. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- On 2025-12-18, the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- As of 2025-10-24, Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-10-24 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-24]

Question: When did Atlas take over the catalog?
